name: Bellanca Viking / Super Viking 17-30/31
summary: Fast four-seat, low-wing retractable-gear tourer from the 1960s–70s, descended from the Cruisair line and recognized by its large vertical fin.

engines: Single six-cylinder Continental in a long cowl
Constant-speed propeller on a pointed spinner
fuselage: Slim four-seat cabin with a streamlined, sloping nose
tail: Oversized, tall vertical fin with a rounded top

tellTales: Low-wing four-seater with a tall, oversized fin
Slim, sloping nose with a retractable tricycle gear
Long, clean wing with no struts

confusedWith.howToTell: The Viking has a much larger, taller fin and a slimmer cabin; the A36 has a shorter fin and a deeper cabin with a big rear cargo door.
The Viking has a single tall vertical fin and a normal horizontal tail; the V35 has a V-tail.
The Viking's fin is tall and swept back; the Mooney's tail is forward-swept with a small cabin.
The Viking has a very tall fin and slim fuselage; the Commander 112/114 has a bulkier, deeper cabin.
